Proportion Of Population With Access To Improved Drinking Water Sources
column4: As defined by the World Health Organisation (WHO), i.e., water sources that, by nature of construction or through active intervention, are protected from outside contamination.  These include piped water into premises, protected dug well etc.  Data are used for SDG 6.1.1 'Proportion of population using safely managed drinking water services'.

column2: Proportion Of Population With Access To Improved Sanitation
column4: As defined by WHO, i.e., sanitation facilities that hygienically separate human excreta from human contact.  These include flush/pour flush toilets or latrines connected to a sewer, septic tank etc.  Data are used for SDG 6.2.1 'Proportion of population using (a) safely managed sanitation services and (b) a hand-washing facility with soap and water'.
